texte.Ce qu'on mesure, comment, quand, par qui: What is measured, how, when, by whom — and when the results are evaluated.
texte.Ce que ce module n’a PAS pu vérifier: What this module could NOT verify
texte.Ce que la direction doit avoir sous les: What senior management must have in front of it: follow-up of previous reviews, changes, performance, nonconformities, feedback from interested parties, results of the risk assessment.
texte.Ce que le système doit consigner, et ce: What the system must record, and what the organisation deems necessary to add to it.
texte.Chaque ligne n'invoque que les paragraph: Each row invokes only the paragraphs that bind its role
texte.Choisir les options, déterminer les mesu: Choose the options, determine the necessary controls, compare them with Annex A to check that none has been omitted, produce the Statement of Applicability, formulate the treatment plan — and have the risk owners APPROVE this plan and ACCEPT the residual risks.

texte.Controle editorial humain (art. # par. #: Human editorial control (art. # para. #): systematic human review before publication; editorial responsibility assumed by name
texte.Des objectifs mesurables, datés, avec un: Measurable, dated objectives with an owner — and the plan that says how they will be achieved.
texte.Disponibilité, protection, distribution,: Availability, protection, distribution, retention, deletion — including for documents of external origin.
texte.Définir les CRITÈRES — dont les critères: Define the CRITERIA — including the acceptance criteria — BEFORE assessing; then identify, analyse and evaluate the risks to confidentiality, integrity and availability, designating an owner for each.
texte.Détermination du domaine d'application d: Determining the scope of the information security management system
texte.Faire tourner ce qui a été planifié, maî: Run what has been planned, control changes, and keep hold of outsourced processes — subcontracting does not leave the scope.
texte.Fonction d'assistance a l'edition standa: Assistive function for standard editing, or no substantial modification of the input data.
texte.Fréquence, méthodes, responsabilités, co: Frequency, methods, responsibilities, reports — and auditors who do not audit their own work.
texte.IAF MD # et ses amendements, relayés par: IAF MD # and its amendments, relayed by the national accreditation body (COFRAC in France) and by the organisation’s certification body
texte.Identification, format, revue et approba: Identification, format, review and approval: the ordinary documentation discipline of management systems.
texte.Il ajoute une considération aux articles: It adds a consideration to clauses # and # without touching Annex A: ignoring it is a minor audit gap, but a gap.
texte.Indicateurs de performance et de dérive,: Performance and drift indicators, incidents, periodic review whose frequency depends on the class.
texte.Interagit-il directement avec des person: Does it interact directly with people, or generate content that is disseminated?
texte.L'appréciation, exécutée à intervalles p: The assessment, performed at planned intervals AND when something changes significantly, with its results retained.
texte.L'article # cree une transparence ciblee: Article # creates targeted transparency. It does not require labelling all “AI-generated” content: each paragraph targets a specific situation and a specific recipient. What the firm does beyond that is a commitment, not an obligation — and saying so is what gives the marking its value where it is due.
texte.L'information doit etre claire, distinct: The information must be clear, distinguishable and provided at the latest at the time of the first interaction or exposure.
texte.L'usage est-il opéré par un tiers, ou re: Is the use operated by a third party, or does it rely on a model supplied by a third party?
texte.L'usage relève-t-il d'une pratique inter: Does the use fall under a prohibited practice (social scoring, manipulation, emotion recognition in the workplace, predictive policing)?
texte.L'usage touche-t-il un domaine de l'anne: Does the use touch an Annex III area (employment, education, credit, essential services, migration, justice, biometrics, critical infrastructure)?
texte.L'état de l'amendement ISO/IEC #:#/Amd #: The status of amendment ISO/IEC #:#/Amd # on climate change (clauses # and #)
texte.La direction revoit le système à interva: Senior management reviews the system at planned intervals.
texte.La direction s'engage, et ça se prouve :: Senior management commits, and it can be proven: resources allocated, decisions made, the subject carried to the highest level.
texte.La matrice RACI détaillée — # rôles, # p: The detailed RACI matrix — # roles, # processes, sector variants — is held by the “Stakeholders” module. This module does not duplicate it: it applies its roles to the committee and the workflow.
texte.La politique d'usage ne produit d'effet: The use policy only has an effect if it is known.
texte.Le cadre : ce que la planification doit: The framework: what planning must produce, and what it relies on.
texte.Le cadre de l'article # est complet et c: The Article # framework is complete and consistent (# §, # cases, # levels)
texte.Le comité de gouvernance IA arbitre les: The AI governance committee decides on the uses of artificial intelligence in the organisation: it authorises or refuses a new use, settles trade-offs between business value and exposure, and suspends a system whose monitoring reveals a drift.
texte.Le document court qui fixe le cap de la: The short document that sets the course for information security and commits the senior management that signs it.
texte.Le nombre importe moins que la certitude: The number matters less than the certainty of having identified them all.
texte.Le plan de traitement, mis en œuvre, et: The treatment plan, implemented, and the evidence that it has been.
texte.Le système produit-il une décision ou un: Does the system produce a decision or an assessment concerning a person?
texte.Le système s'audite lui-même, à interval: The system audits itself, at planned intervals.
texte.Le vert de ce parcours dit que ce qu'un: Green on this path means that what a block expects has been filled in. It does not mean that you are compliant: only an accredited certification body can declare that, at the end of a two-stage audit.
texte.Les changements du système se planifient: Changes to the system are planned; they are not discovered after the fact. Clause added by the # edition.
texte.Les décisions prises — et les ressources: The decisions taken — and the resources committed to deliver them.
texte.Les hypertrucages (deepfakes) doivent et: Deepfakes must be disclosed as artificially generated or manipulated. Texts published to inform the public on matters of public interest must also be disclosed when they are generated or manipulated by AI.
texte.Les indicateurs sans valeur ne sont pas: Indicators without a value are not at zero: they are not yet measured. Reviews and awareness are entered outside this module.
texte.Les moyens humains, techniques et financ: Human, technical and financial resources, determined and provided — not hoped for.
texte.Les personnes doivent etre informees qu': People must be informed that they are interacting with an AI system.
texte.Les personnes exposees a un systeme de r: People exposed to an emotion recognition or biometric categorisation system must be informed of it.
texte.Les systemes generant du texte, de l'ima: Systems generating synthetic text, image, audio or video must enable MACHINE-DETECTABLE marking of the generated or manipulated content.

texte.Ne concerne aucun contenu genere : c'est: Does not concern any generated content: it is exposure to the system that triggers the information.
texte.Ne cree aucune obligation nouvelle : il: Creates no new obligation: it governs the form of those in § # to § # that already apply.
texte.Ni les contenus internes, ni les livrabl: Neither internal content nor deliverables handed to a client: publication to the public, and its subject, are the condition.
texte.Nommer ce qui, dehors et dedans, pèse su: Name what, outside and inside, weighs on information security: market, applicable law, technical dependencies, internal maturity.
texte.Non requis : contenu NON genere par IA (: Not required: content NOT generated by AI (taken over without rewording; selection by keywords does not constitute generation)
texte.Non requis : exception invoquee — mentio: Not required: exception invoked — transparency and editorial responsibility notice published on the News page — IN PLACE
texte.Objectifs de sécurité de l'information e: Information security objectives and planning to achieve them
texte.Oeuvre manifestement artistique, creativ: Evidently artistic, creative, satirical or fictional work: lighter transparency, without hampering the work. For texts: human review or editorial control with editorial responsibility assumed.
texte.Part des usages qualifiés AI Act: Share of uses qualified under the AI Act
texte.Pertinence, adéquation et efficacité du: Suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the system, continually improved.
texte.Protection des données, nécessité d'une: Data protection, need for a DPIA
texte.Que les personnes concernées sachent ce: That the people concerned know what is expected of them and what a failure produces.
texte.Qui communique quoi, à qui, quand et par: Who communicates what, to whom, when and through which channel — internally as well as externally.
texte.Qui décide, qui met en œuvre, qui contrô: Who decides, who implements, who checks — and who reports to senior management on the performance of the system.
texte.Rapports generes par Sentinel (IA Act an: Reports generated by Sentinel (annual AI Act, GDPR audit, art. # attestation)
texte.Recenser qui exige quoi — clients, régul: List who requires what — clients, regulators, insurers, employees — and which of these requirements will be addressed by the management system.
texte.Responsable IA, enregistrement au regist: AI owner, recording in the register · # step(s)
texte.Rien sur le contenu produit : c'est l'in: Nothing on the content produced: it is the interaction that is flagged, not what comes out of it.
texte.Rien à saisir : l'écran explique. Il se: Nothing to enter: the screen explains. It is marked “read”, and “read” is not green.
texte.Réagir, en corriger les conséquences, ch: React, correct the consequences, look for the cause, act on the cause, and check that it worked.
texte.SANS OBJET, et c'est examine, pas oublie: NOT APPLICABLE, and this has been examined, not forgotten: the platform operates no emotion recognition or biometric categorisation system, and processes no biometric data.
texte.Sans objet (echange interactif, non diff: Not applicable (interactive exchange, not disseminated as a publication)
texte.Sans objet (redaction assistee, publicat: Not applicable (assisted writing, published under editorial responsibility)
texte.Sauf si cela est evident au regard du co: Unless this is obvious from the context of use.
texte.Savoir quelles compétences le système ex: Know which competences the system requires, check that you have them, and close the gap.
texte.Texte (reponses aux clients, moteurs Cla: Text (responses to clients, Claude and Mistral engines)
texte.Texte d'interet public elabore avec l'as: Text of public interest prepared with the assistance of an AI
texte.Texte de synthese genere par IA, avec ci: Summary text generated by AI, with citations
texte.Titres et resumes repris des sources ext: Titles and summaries taken from external sources
texte.Traite-t-il des données personnelles (mê: Does it process personal data (even non-sensitive)?
texte.Traite-t-il des données personnelles sen: Does it process sensitive personal data (health, biometrics, opinions, trade union membership)?
texte.Un circuit lent se contourne. Ce chiffre: A slow workflow gets bypassed. This figure measures the risk of shadow AI as much as the committee’s efficiency.
texte.Un comité qui n'a jamais rien refusé ne: A committee that has never refused anything does not decide: it records.
texte.Un registre incomplet rend toutes les au: An incomplete register makes every other measurement wrong.
texte.Un usage non qualifié est un usage dont: An unqualified use is a use whose obligations are unknown.
texte.Une file qui s'allonge annonce des mises: A growing queue heralds go-lives outside the workflow.
texte.Une revue en retard sur un système à hau: An overdue review on a high-risk system is a compliance gap.
texte.Usages autorises a des fins de detection: Uses authorised for the purpose of detecting or preventing criminal offences, under the conditions laid down by the Regulation.
texte.Validation de la valeur d'usage et de l': Validation of the use value and of adoption

texte.taux qui dit l’effort réel. Les articles: rate that shows the real effort. The “shareable” clauses graft onto a management system already in place — ISO # shares exactly the same structure — and those marked “specific to security” are the # that carry over from nowhere.

texte.Écrire ce qui est dedans et ce qui est d: Write down what is in and what is out. It is the most structuring decision of the certification: everything that is not excluded in writing will be audited.
texte.Établir, mettre en œuvre, tenir à jour e: Establish, implement, maintain and improve the system — the clause that requires the rest to exist for real.
